messages:
jordan: Hey team — customer (AcmeRetail) reports streaming responses cut off mid-stream, then client gets a 429 and a reconnect attempt. They say they received ~30 tokens of partial text but their usage shows entire request charged (huge spike). They sent curl logs.
jordan: Repro steps attached from customer: curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' --data '{\"model\":\"gpt-4o-mini\",\"prompt\":\"long multi-turn output...\"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream
jordan: Customer says sequence: stream begins, partial SSE events for ~2s, then stream closes with HTTP/1.1 200 but final event is: event: error
data: {\"code\":429,\"message\":\"quota exceeded midstream\"} — client then retries and sees unexpected billing.
maya: Ugh. Any request-id headers?
jordan: They included response headers in logs: x-rw-request-id: rq_0b2f9, x-rw-quota-remaining: 0, x-rw-token-usage: 512, x-rw-stream-state: aborted
maya: Thanks. Does the client use retry-on-429 logic? Looks like the client retries automatically and resends full prompt which could lead to double-charge.
ryan: Paging eng-runtime. @ryan can you check whether rate-limiter can emit 429 mid-sse without final accounting? Also whether x-rw-token-usage is final or streaming-updated?
ryan: I see a deploy-bot message: deploy-bot: rollout v2.14.3 -> production (serving/runtime) — completed 1765011200. Could be related to new token flush behavior. :eyes:
luke: I'm oncall, grabbing logs for rq_0b2f9. Can we get a minimal repro? I'll try the customer's curl in a sandbox.
jordan: Customer gave a minimal prompt that reliably produces long output. They also said disabling automatic client retry avoids double billing. They want server-side guidance to return a clear Retry-After and not count tokens twice.
ryan: Quick summary of how accounting is supposed to work: streaming runtime emits interim usage headers per chunk (x-rw-stream-tokens) but final billing delta is applied at stream close/finalization. If a 429 is returned by the upstream quota check mid-stream, we should return an event: error with code 429 and include x-rw-final-usage and Retry-After. Looks like the finalization didn't happen.
maya: I'm seeing customer charged the full model call (1024 tokens) though they only received ~120 tokens in SSE. That's the spike.
luke: Repro attempt logs:
```
$ curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer token-jordan" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","prompt":"long output test"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream
event: message
data: {"choices":[{"delta":"Hello ..."}]}
... (many chunks)
event: message
data: {"choices":[{"delta":"...partial end"}]}
event: error
data: {"code":429,"message":"quota exceeded midstream"}
HTTP/1.1 200\nheaders: x-rw-request-id: rq_0b2f9
         x-rw-stream-finalized: false
         x-rw-token-usage: 1024
```
luke: Notice stream-finalized:false but token-usage shows 1024. That mismatch is suspicious.
ryan: I'm attaching recent runtime logs for rq_0b2f9 (copied here): 
```
[2026-02-10T09:12:34Z] stream.open rq=0b2f9 client=acct-acmeretail
[2026-02-10T09:12:35Z] chunk.emit size=64 tokens=60
[2026-02-10T09:12:36Z] chunk.emit size=48 tokens=40
[2026-02-10T09:12:36Z] quota.check -> negative remaining -> 429 scheduled
[2026-02-10T09:12:36Z] stream.abort reason=quota_exceeded
[2026-02-10T09:12:36Z] billing.snapshot applied=1024 tentative=false
```
ryan: Looks like billing.snapshot applied despite stream.abort. I suspect a race: quota check is async and billing flush path runs concurrently, causing full-charge even though stream aborted mid-chunk.
maya: If that's the case, customer sees overcharge. What's recommended mitigation short-term?
ryan: Immediate mitigation: set client to not auto-retry on 429 midstream, and update token-count presentation so support can refund. On platform side, we should ensure billing applies only if stream-finalized=true OR the snapshot has a finalized flag.
luke: I'll open an internal incident and tag eng-runtime and billing. Also will revert the recent change in rollout v2.14.3 to the token flush path if needed.
deploy-bot: rollback candidate detected for v2.14.3 — manual approval required.
maya: For customer-facing message: apologize, explain they hit quota limit mid-stream, recommend disabling automatic retries, and offer a billing review. I'll propose a temporary credit while we investigate.
jordan: Customer agreed to a short window credit. They also provided SDK logs showing the client reissued the same request after getting the 429 event.
ryan: Action items:
- (ryan) add guard so billing.snapshot only applies if stream state == finalized  — ticket ENG-RUNTIME-7641
- (luke) create incident with rollback plan and keep customer updated — INC-1765
- (billing) audit charge for acct-acmeretail and issue provisional credit if duplicate charge found
- (support/maya) send customer clear guidance + temporary credit offer
maya: I'll put a draft message here in 15 and then send. Thanks all. :pray:
jordan: TY — customer is relieved we took it seriously.
billing-bot: billing-audit queued for acct-acmeretail (rq_0b2f9).
